fixes.explanation: Right, friend. Paul says, "I always thank my God for you because of the grace He has given you in Christ Jesus." (1 Corinthians 1:4). His thanks goes to God, and the reason is the grace God has given them. It's the same word, grace, that he just used in his greeting. When a batch comes out right, I don't pat my own mustache on the back, and Paul doesn't pat the Corinthians on the back either.
